selection.eligibility: the normalized row must pass the frozen MARKET_ANCHOR_1X2_V2 prospective evaluator before it can be selected

notes: This is a prospective artifact-cohort deduplication rule only; it does not change the frozen model, 19 features, weights, lambda semantics, source/quote age limits, or the 30-event gate.
All captured candidates are validated before selection. No candidate is selected using a target outcome or a performance metric.
Repeated forward artifacts for one fixture contribute only the first eligible capture. Equal capture timestamps fail closed instead of using an arbitrary tie-break.
